# Retatrutide — The First Triple Agonist for Weight Loss

> retatrutide.md is an evidence-based guide to retatrutide, Eli Lilly's first-in-class triple agonist targeting GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors: phase 3 trial results, mechanism of action, expected approval timeline, dosing, side effects, and comparisons with semaglutide and tirzepatide. Part of the thrive.md health network.
